FunctionInput_ocean_io_searchskillsugges.description: Skill-name prefix and optional suggestion limit.

items.description: Skill-name suggestions in provider order; empty if none match.

FunctionOutput_ocean_io_searchskillsugge.description: One set of supported skill-name suggestions.

tags.instructions: Use this to select skill text for person discovery. Use `search-job-title-suggestions` for title vocabulary instead. Request 1–15 suggestions, default 5; results are not pageable.

functions.name: update-exclusion-list
functions.description: Replace an exclusion list's display name without changing its type or members.

name.description: Replacement display name; empty string is passed unchanged. Omission and null are not allowed.

exclusionListId.description: Opaque identifier of the list to rename.

FunctionInput_ocean_io_updateexclusionli.description: The exclusion list to rename and its replacement display name.

id.description: Identifier of the list whose rename request succeeded.

name.description: Replacement display name submitted successfully; not an additional read-back of provider normalization.

FunctionOutput_ocean_io_updateexclusionl.description: The list identifier and submitted display name after a successful rename request.

tags.instructions: Get exclusionListId from `list-exclusion-lists`. This tool changes only the display name; use membership tools to add or remove members and `delete-exclusion-list` to delete the list. Null is not a supported name; an empty string is sent as an empty display name.
